rulings.decision: Ratified, and widened from one instance to its class. The doubled punctuation is a W4-only class: seven same-character doubles in four W4 fields, each a byte-exact RP quotation that ends with the witness's own comma or full stop followed by the author's own sentence comma or full stop. Not gating for the primaries: no boundary, verse range, evidence ref, confidence or quotation byte is affected. The seven spans are licensed for a mechanical one-character fix in the first fix-up wave after the primaries and the round-4 rulings (not now): delete the second character of each doubled pair, so every quotation stays byte-identical to RP. The fourteen mixed pairs (witness punctuation followed by a different author punctuation) are not ordered; they go to the end review as a quotation-punctuation convention question.
rulings.reason: S3 named one instance; a whole-corpus scan of the applied rows for a Greek letter followed by a doubled comma or full stop finds exactly these seven spans and none outside W4. Deleting the second character keeps the RP slice intact (RP 11:17 'οὐκ ἐπαινῶ,', 11:20 'αὐτό,', 11:22 '... Οὐκ ἐπαινῶ.', 11:23 'ὑμῖν,', 11:27 'κυρίου,', 11:33 'Ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου,' are byte-checked), so rule 2 is kept. The mixed pairs read as quotation-final punctuation plus sentence punctuation; whether a quotation should end before its witness punctuation is a method convention for the whole campaign, not a W4 defect, so this ruling does not order it.
